Carlsbad Caverns

The following Incident Reports were extracted from the NPS Morning Reports/Coalition Reports from 1989-current. They are not a complete record of all incidents which occurred in this park during this timeframe.

INCIDENTS

Monday, June 23, 1986
Carlsbad Cavern - Flash Flood

Rains started early Monday -- very heavy with flash floods. Had to close access road at 10 a.m. Water reached 3-1/2' depth at dry arroyo crossings as of 9:30 p.m. 400 people stranded at Caverns. Used paper sleeping bags from fire cache, food supplies from fire cache & concessioner & park residents.

Still raining this morning & flash flood warnings still up. Currents too strong for either cars or buses.

Tuesday, August 10, 2004
Grand Canyon National Park (AZ)
Multiple Incidents on South Rim

Between July 29th and August 2nd, South Rim rangers dealt with the following significant incidents:

  • Credit Card Fraud — A suspect was arrested following a several month long investigation of credit card theft and fraud. A warrant was obtained and she was charged with fraud (18 USC 1029 (5)).
  • Medical — Rangers responded to an unconscious 32-year-old woman with a cardiac and medical history.
